item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - GBI - Towa Tei & Kylie Minogue (Takkyu Ishino Remix) + Other Rare Kylie Remixes
item.description:
Hi all,

Requesting GBI (Takkyu Ishino Remix) + Takkyu Ishino Dub that were only available on a 2017 Japanese single pre-ordered through Towa Tei's website. The remix runs 6:24

Additionally requesting GBI (Kylie pella) mix running at 1:40.

While you're here, I'm just gonna throw out some other rare Kylie Minogue remixes I can't find anywhere, if anyone has them:
- We Know The Meaning of Love (Edit) 3:15
- Better the Devil You Know (Hot Tracks Mad March Hare Mix Re-Edit) 7:13
- Better the Devil You Know (Hot Tracks US Remix Re-Edit) 5:56
- What Kind of Fool (Heard All That Before) [Original 7" version available ONLY on a South African greatest hits CD released in 2011]
- Where is the Feeling (Aphroheadz Powerlite Mix) 6:08
- Where is the Feeling (Thee Rad Vid Clash Mix) 7:08

In My Arms (feat. Jolin Tsai) [Chinese edition]
